name: Domestic facilitators linked to worker activity and false official-record registration

attribution.legal_posture: Government-reported sanctions or law-enforcement finding; the record is limited to the cited event.

ttps: Japanese police reported arresting a Japanese man and a South Korean national whose relationship with DPRK IT workers was established; they were initially arrested for fraud and rearrested for causing false information to be recorded in an electromagnetic official record and using it.
caveats: Names, victim data, and identifying documents are excluded from collection.
